notes.title: Road to Launch: Three New Mutations
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265673/af316ba983be3f4f783fa276c68b8ca7ca7cc15b.gif[/img]

[b]Three new mutations added, bringing the total to 23![/b]

Mutations are the automatic weapons in FIENDRISE, each one is unique and can evolve further by meeting specific conditions. One example is the new Alien Claw, which fires extra bubbles based on the player's defense!

Here’s a quick rundown of the three new mutations:

• Alien Claw: fires piercing bubbles that deal high damage. The damage scales with the player's attack, mutation level, and defense, enabling a hybrid tank playstyle.

• Devil Eye: summons a minion every 8 seconds that fires piercing attacks at nearby enemies. The spawn rate and firepower of these summons can be increased, making for a true summoner-like playstyle.

• Sbrongo: leaves a trail of poisonous bubbles. Its evolution unlocks a unique mechanic: poison damage that scales with the player's MAX HP!

More to come~

notes.title: FIENDRISE Demo - Update v0.22.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265673/d3c381b37ff4db867704a56eae749c81d6c9ac70.gif[/img]

In the past week, I polished the demo and created a new system to make defeating bosses even more rewarding.

Here's a quick recap:
[list]
[*] Boss Rewards: Defeating a boss now spawns 3 random rewards. Pick one: permanent stat boosts, flat gold, or an extra reroll.
[*] Enemy Patterns: Some melee enemies now have unique and unpredictable movement patterns.
[*] Fiend Scaling: All fiends (playable characters) gain more MAX HP per level.
[*] Neofiend Buffs: The Laser Beam skill (Q) now pierces, and its rotating beams have updated visuals.
[*] Carnivorosa Buffs: The Tanglebloom skill (W) evolves at 4 power. Poison scaling now benefits from HP, defense, and power, enabling defensive builds.
[*] Smaller Stages: Stages are ~30% smaller for better exploration flow, but encounter rarity remains unchanged.
[*] Enemy Speed: Minor adjustments to enemy speeds.
[*] Mutations: Various changes and fixes.
[/list]

From now on, I'll focus on the full game as the release is still planned for March 2025 🤞
